# Physics Society (PhySoc) - IIT Kharagpur

Welcome to the Physics Society of IIT Kharagpur (PhySoc). We are a student-run society passionate about the cosmos, quantum worlds, and the fundamental laws of nature.

## Architecture
The site is built as a static site consisting of HTML, CSS, and Vanilla JS, using `anime.js` for premium animations.
No backend logic is required to serve the files. It can be hosted on Vercel, Netlify, or GitHub Pages.

## Sections
- /about/: Learn about our mission, history, values, and activities like Feynman Lectures, UROP, Stargazing, and more.
- /announcements/: Stay updated with events, academic opportunities, and society news.
- /resources/: Access curated textbooks, notes, and roadmaps for physics students.
- /officers/: Meet the leadership team of PhySoc.
- /sandbox/: Explore interactive physics simulations built by our members (e.g., Orbital Mechanics, Double Pendulum).
- /contact/: Get in touch with us for queries or collaborations.
- /admin/: Officer panel for managing announcements and checking contact submissions.
